title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Reveals Key Visual After Episode 10 Premiere
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA revealed a key visual after the premiere of Episode 10. The new visual features all the members of Mugendai MewType. Additionally, Maaya Uchida, Konomi Kohara, and Miho Okasaki join the series’ cast as Yuno’s former bandmates. Episode 10 is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Muse Asia.

title: A One Piece x SpongeBob SquarePants Animated Crossover Video Has Landed
content: This summer, a crossover unlike any other has been teased to arrive in North America and various other countries around the world. The Straw Hat Pirates and the residents of Bikini Bottom are on a collision course, as McDonald’s is set to release fusion figures that reimagine all the parties involved.

title: A Bona Fide Killer Webtoon Views Rise 10-Fold Following Live-Action Series Premiere
content: Kakao Entertainment announced on August 18 that views for the original A Bona Fide Killer webtoon have increased tenfold following the premiere of its MBC television series adaptation .
author: ANN

title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2 Unveils New Visual, Theme Songs, October 8 Premiere Date
content: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2 unveiled a new key visual along with the opening and ending theme songs and an October 8 premiere date. Sizuk will perform the opening theme song “Diamond Dust” while Maaya Uchida will sing “COMPRESSION :[“, the ending theme song. ZERO-G is animating the sequel.

title: How Do We Relationship? Live-Action Series Reveals Opening Theme in Promo Video
content: MBS began streaming a short promotional video on Thursday for the live-action series adaptation of Tamifull 's How Do We Relationship? ( Tsukiatte Agete mo Ii ka na ) manga. The video reveals and previews the opening theme song "Kyakuhon" (Script) by Pilaf Alien .
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Stays at #1, 5th Live-Action Kingdom Rises to #5 in Japan
content: Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, stayed at #1 in its fourth weekend. The film sold 602,000 tickets and earned 895,266,300 yen (about US$5.62 million) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Supporting Cast Pair
content: The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai ( The Ghost in the Shell ) television anime announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on July 7 at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates.
